findings.text: The reviewed run's delivered manifest is truncated mid-token at 1119 bytes: its last line ends 'reckon/crew/promotion_placeholder' with no newline, and the file carries no tests:, test_logs:, negative_control_log:, baseline_suite:, after_suite:, landing:, artifacts: or rubric.* lines. The node's write paths include tests/ and its negative_control is not 'none', so negative_control_log and the gate evidence are required of this record; a promotion reading /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261114T202223396248-sspb-the-queue-reads-as-a-queue-from-the-cli-mcp-and/manifest.md would find neither the repair round's scoped gate (scoped-gate-1794993336927296990.log, 7 passed EXIT=0 at 1441625a6e) nor any suite arm, while the complete pre-repair record survives only as manifest.md.attempt-1.asdelivered.

The repair paragraph attributes a refusal to 'the typed MCP surface' and says CrewArgs's Literal 'refused' the queue view, but no production module reads CrewArgs: reckon/mcp.py:2709 declares the crew tool's view as 'str' and reckon/mcp.py:3837 builds the published argument model from tool.fn_metadata.arg_model, so the crew tool always accepted view="queue" and CrewArgs is a test-only mirror. The paragraph overstates the runtime effect of the omission it repaired; the guard that fired is real, but a reader should be told the mirror and the skill were what disagreed with the dispatcher, not the published schema.

The repair adds the queue entry to _TOP_LEVEL_COMPOSITION_STAMPS (line 335) and the new _VIEW_COMPOSITION_AGES map (line 347) so the queue comparison tolerates the queue read's composition stamp and read-instant ages, but no assertion drives either entry: test_only_the_budget_views_own_stamp_is_dropped (line 441) exercises only the budget and reviews shapes, so deleting the queue entries or widening them to every view leaves the gate green. Widening _VIEW_COMPOSITION_AGES to every view would also hide a genuine queue-field disagreement between the two surfaces, because the filter drops keys from both sides before comparison.
